name: skillbench
description: A/B benchmark harness for measuring LLM agent rule-compliance under Context Engineering / Agent Skills

scripts.calibrate: node src/runner.mjs --adapter claude-cli --arms A1 --reps 5 && node scripts/calibrate.mjs
scripts.dilution: node src/runner.mjs --adapter claude-cli --config config/dilution.json --scenarios S08,S09 --reps 15 && node scripts/dilution-report.mjs
